sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels team,

Thank you for your offer. We are ready to commit for 24 months, 47,400 kg in total, and we accept your request for an AS-14404 price adjustment clause, with a 5% deadband, on 90 days payment.

Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm were at EUR 5.26 until June 2026 and have been at EUR 5.84 since July 2026 (po:4500014078-10, po:4500014140-10, po:4500014427-10).

We propose EUR 4.77 per kg on these terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We are prepared to accept your request for a 24-month contract, the AS-14404 index clause, and the extended 90-day payment terms. Under these agreed conditions, we propose a revised price of EUR 5.50 per kg. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

To summarize, our offer comprises a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While this slight increase does not yield significant economies of scale, we are willing to make a further concession to support our partnership. 

We therefore propose a revised price of EUR 5.40 per kg, maintaining the 24-month contract, 90-day payment terms, and the AS-14404 index clause. For full clarity, our revised Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to move. To reach an agreement, we can offer a further concession to EUR 5.30 per kg under the agreed terms. This represents a fair compromise that reflects our current cost structure while supporting our partnership.

Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. As our full Angebot, we are pleased to present a price of €5.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation and hope this proposal meets your expectations.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
